title: Assess explicit root-wide source capture admission hardening without changing content-v1 compatibility implicitly
outcome: A separate evidence-backed proposal for any future no-gitlink root admission tightening, with exact compatibility consequences and consumer migration; no change is smuggled into pinned-submodule support.
acceptance: The assessment identifies current admission and guarantee limits for sparse/partial roots, hidden index flags, conflicts, and changes between capture reads, with source evidence.
Any proposed tightening states formerly admitted states that would refuse, compatibility and consumer migration consequences, and an explicit coordinator disposition before implementation.
